# Kwagi

Kwagi is an offline study app for notes, user-created flashcards, quizzes, spaced repetition, and local progress tracking.

- [Privacy Policy](https://tsutsu03.github.io/kwagi-app/privacy/)
- [Support](https://tsutsu03.github.io/kwagi-app/support/)

The current release has no accounts, ads, analytics, cloud sync, payments, or AI service.
